title: Existing-Home Sales (NAR, October 2026 data) — the year's cleanest solo GDPNow vintage, and a tape already measured inert 100 times, 10:00 a.m. ET
source: IR: the publisher's own forward calendar — nar.realtor/press-releases/nar-statistical-news-release-schedule (fetched direct 2026-09-06, HTTP 200, 483,177 bytes; the /newsroom/ path the sibling ledgers cite now 308-redirects here), whose 2026 table reads verbatim "NOVEMBER | Thu., Nov. 12 | October Existing-Home Sales" under the page's standing note "All releases at 10 a.m. Eastern Time", and its downloadable twin /sites/default/files/2025-11/2026-nar-statistical-news-release-schedule.docx (HTTP 200, 55,384 bytes, published 2025-11), which carries the full year and the same November row. Promoted from the `EST:` single-source proposal filed 2026-09-06 by the existing-home-sales-2026-12-09 sweep, on the same precedent that lane used for its own date (challenger-job-cuts-2026-09-03: a private publisher's own release carried IR:/confirmed; NAR is the producer of this series, not an aggregator). Corroborated independently this session: the seven 2026 EHS dates the Atlanta Fed's GDPTrackingModelDataAndForecasts.xlsx ContribArchives has actually posted vintages for (01-14, 02-12, 03-10, 04-13, 05-11, 06-09, 07-09) match NAR's published 2026 calendar 7 for 7, and NAR's live statistics page separately names the next edition ("Existing-Home Sales for August 2026 will be released on Thursday, September 10, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern"), the same schedule's September row. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: The October edition, and the ledger that inverts the reason it was proposed. The proposing lane filed it as "the unconfounded control" whose TAPE is the readable thing, on the premise that the Atlanta Fed's PostedUpdates does not schedule a vintage for 2026-11-12 and that "GDPNow posts a vintage only on the release days it schedules". That premise is measurably false from the Fed's own two workbooks: over their overlapping window (2025-12-23 -> 2026-07-28) PostedUpdates schedules 48 posting days while ContribArchives records 93 actually posted, so 45 of 93 (48.4%) realized vintages were never scheduled and zero scheduled dates went unposted — the schedule is a floor, never a ceiling. On the class in question the pattern is exact: all 7 realized 2026 EHS release dates got a vintage, 5 of the 7 were unscheduled, and every one of those 5 named "Existing-home sales" ALONE. So 11-12's likely nowcast reading is a SOLO EHS vintage — the most attributable kind there is (123 of 140 EHS-naming vintages 2014-05-01 -> 2026-07-28 are solo; a solo one moves change-in-inventory-investment under 0.10pp 123 times out of 123, median 0.0001pp, and moves residential investment a median 0.0399pp) — which is cleaner than the shared 12-09 vintage, not absent. The tape half inverts too: `symbols: []` is re-derived here on 2,514 daily sessions 2016-09-06 -> 2026-09-04 (Nasdaq API; Yahoo hard-429'd this runner all session, and the closes reproduce the sibling's Yahoo pull exactly — SPY 770.19, ITB 93.91, XHB 103.25, VIX 14.53 from CBOE), and the control this event was proposed to provide has ALREADY been run 100 times unconfounded: on the 100 solo EHS release days ITB reads a 1.915% median session range against 1.863% baseline (permutation p=0.61), XHB 1.728% vs 1.660% (p=0.49), SPY 0.897% vs 0.883% (p=0.84). Impact stays `low` and no instrument attaches. Three confound axes were tested and all three clear, so the session IS clean even though the tape has nothing to say: the Fed's own 2026 panel has eight meetings and none in November; a session two trading days after a CPI print is if anything narrower (ITB 1.705% vs 1.877%, n=111, p=0.084); and the session after a bond-market-only holiday is baseline (1.784% vs 1.873%, n=20, p=0.69) though the holiday itself is quieter (1.341%, p=0.027). Two corrections to the proposal's corridor arithmetic: 11-12 is THREE days after the 11-09 wholesale print (not six) and SIX days before the 11-18 October PHSI (not four). Date is `confirmed` on the publisher's own calendar; that licenses nothing, and the ledger's call is stand aside on every horizon. Discovered in the existing-home-sales-2026-12-09 adjacency sweep 2026-09-06; canonical file written by this event's own initial research the same day, which shadows that proposal.
